path.title: Bayern - partial: point cloud, terrain, houses (missing: plots)

Niedersachsen - full: point cloud, terrain, plots, houses. Priced route: LGLN sells the classified ALS Laserscan-Punktwolke (3D-Messdaten) under the KOVerm fee schedule: 1 km2 LAZ 1.2 tiles, >=4 pts/m2, quote on request, delivered by download or on a posted data carrier. Not CC BY like the DGM1 -- it comes under the LGLN AGNB. Ask geoService-3D@lgln.niedersachsen.de.
Nordrhein-Westfalen - full: point cloud, terrain, plots, houses

Baden-Württemberg - full: point cloud, terrain, plots, houses. Priced route: LGL's ALS_2 covers all of Baden-Wuerttemberg from the 2016-2021 campaign at >=8 pts/m2, in LAZ, LAS or XYZ-ASCII, and is licensed Open Data -- but it ships on an email order with an effort-based Service-Entgelt, minimum 60 EUR plus VAT. ALS_3 (the 2022-2029 recapture) is the same arrangement and still in progress; ALS_1 (2000-2005, 0.8 pts/m2) is historic and no longer maintained. Ask geodaten@lgl.bwl.de.
Brandenburg - full: point cloud, terrain, plots, houses
Mecklenburg-Vorpommern - full: point cloud, terrain, plots, houses

Sachsen-Anhalt - full: point cloud, terrain, plots, houses. Priced route: LVermGeo sells the statewide 3D-Messdaten point cloud (LAS 1.2 or LAZ, 4-8 pts/m2, reflown on a 6-year cycle) at 190 EUR je Datensatz, auf Antrag; DGM and DOM are derived from it and sold separately. What is free is two sample areas and a UI that caps a DGM1 selection at 5 tiles.
Hessen - full: point cloud, terrain, plots, houses. houses: free gds.hessen.de account, Downloadcenter Shape, annual — no endpoint
